title: Add signed NSIS beta productization foundation
summary: Add the first productization foundation for a private-beta Windows app: NSIS-first installer metadata, prompted updater scaffolding, AppData runtime roots, support-export diagnostics, and CI release guardrails.
reason: The promoted Tauri/WebView surface is ready for operator use, but a real downloadable app needs signed installer/update infrastructure, immutable install versus mutable state separation, and beta support artifacts.
behavior_before: The project had release ZIP/package validation and Tauri installer targets, but no NSIS-first productization lane, no updater configuration, no CI signing workflow, no AppData migration contract, and no support export.
behavior_after: The project has an NSIS-first beta release lane with updater and signing scaffolding, AppData migration/support-export contracts, and tests/docs that define the remaining real signing and GitHub release publication prerequisites.
manual_validation: New-TauriProductizationConfig.ps1 fake-key JSON generation smoke - passed
npm run check in apps/desktop/tauri - passed
pytest productization/API/Tauri scaffold contract suite - passed (137 passed, 419 subtests)
rollback_plan: Remove the productization config, updater/diagnostics/AppData modules, CI workflow, tests, docs, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes:
No media policy, FFmpeg/subtitle/audio behavior, source/scratch/output movement, pending-publish drain, rename apply, or WebView-owned mutation authority is intentionally added.
Actual public release publishing still requires protected GitHub secrets, real certificate/updater keys, and manual Windows 10/11 clean-machine validation.
